facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/controller:.data
facts.value: Each HSD_PadInit invocation restores the live controller subsystem from these templates before installing new queue storage. The status template begins with no buttons, edges, repeats, analog values, or normalized values and with a nonzero error state; the library template begins with an empty queue, a 45-update initial repeat delay and 8-update repeat interval, a stick conversion threshold of 30, neutral reset-switch state, and configured clamp and scaling limits. Runtime processing then transitions the copied status records away from these defaults as valid or erroneous PAD samples arrive.
